Campaign 进阶验收 1791572085141：推广面向大学生的降噪耳机，希望提高认知和购买意愿。我只说目标，你先交互询问必要的筛选范围，并思考两类不同创作者；现在不要启动搜索。

明白，**现在只明确范围、讨论创作者类型，不启动搜索**。已确认：产品是面向大学生的降噪耳机，目标是提高认知和购买意愿。

先集中确认 3 点：
1. **市场与平台**：面向哪个国家或地区的大学生？希望在哪些平台推广？创作者所在地是否也需限定？
2. **产品与卖点**：品牌、售价大致是多少？除降噪外，有哪些值得突出且已确认的卖点，例如佩戴舒适、续航或性价比？
3. **筛选规模**：希望总共筛选多少位创作者？有粉丝数区间要求吗？如果没有，我可以提出建议。

初步考虑两类创作者，供你讨论，**尚未作为筛选条件确认**：
- **校园学习／大学生活类**：通过图书馆学习、宿舍生活、通勤等场景，让学生理解产品用途，侧重提高认知与使用兴趣。
- **科技数码／耳机评测类**：通过降噪体验、舒适度及同价位比较，帮助学生判断是否值得购买，侧重提高购买意愿。

你补充上述范围后，我会给出两组的筛选条件与人数分配建议，等你明确同意后再启动。

补充 1791572085141：平台 Instagram，创作者所在地 Canada 或 United States，粉丝 1万至10万。总共需要2位不同账号：1位分享科技/耳机评测内容，1位分享学习/校园生活内容。每类最多2个候选、总预算4。都是必选文字条件，没有视觉条件，不要求邮箱，不做外联。请用 save_campaign_plan 保存这两类的草案，解释类型与目标的关系，标题包含 1791572085141；先不要搜索。

已保存草案 **《大学生降噪耳机推广 Campaign 草案 1791572085141》**，**未启动搜索**。

### 已保存的筛选范围
- **平台**：Instagram
- **创作者所在地**：Canada 或 United States
- **粉丝数**：10,000–100,000
- **目标**：2 位不同账号，每类 1 位
- **候选上限**：每类最多 2 个，总计最多 4 个
- **条件性质**：全部为必选文字条件，无视觉条件
- **其他限制**：不要求邮箱，不做外联

### 两类创作者与目标的关系

| 类型 | 目标人数 | 必选内容条件 | 如何支持推广目标 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| 科技／耳机评测类 | 1 位 | 分享科技或耳机评测内容 | 通过产品体验、功能解释与对比，帮助大学生认识降噪耳机并判断购买价值，支持认知提升与购买意愿。 |
| 学习／校园生活类 | 1 位 | 分享学习或校园生活内容 | 将产品与学习、校园日常等场景联系，增强学生对产品用途的理解与使用兴趣。 |

未额外添加“本人必须在校”“曾评测该品牌”或受众所在地等要求。两组须使用不同的 Instagram 账号，同一账号不能重复计入总人数。

My CEO Day routine for Q4… YIKES it’s Q4 🙃 Now typically I like to do this routine outside of my office to change up my environment, but I haven’t been feeling well so I just kept things at my desk this time. 

As always, I try to organize my P&L report and other KPIs *before* the day starts so I’m not wasting time on admin/accounting and can just focus on the BIG picture of where my business is heading. I also make sure to schedule a fun way to celebrate once I’m finished (usually takes me no more than 2 hours so I’ll take off the rest of the day)! 

I have this whole day in the form of a Notion template that you can grab for yourself for FREE! It’s in my link in bio, just find my free Notion template library sign up and you’ll have access to this and a bunch of other free templates!

My apartment runs itself, and this one is everything that happens while I am asleep.

Shades close at 9:22. Kitchen shelf lights shut off at 9:50, which is my signal that the day is over. The Pura kicks on lavender. My Eight Sleep adjusts the bed temperature all night based on my body. The humidifier holds the room at 60%. And 45 minutes after sunrise the blackout layer opens first, then the solar shades, so I wake up to the skyline instead of an alarm.

I set all of it up once and it has run every night since. That is the whole point of the hometel.

Save this for when you are ready to automate your own space and send it to whoever you share a bed with.

#smarthome #homeautomation #hometel #eightsleep #sleeproutine

Welcome to SchoolHabits

My name is Katie Azevedo. Through private coaching, video tutorials and online courses, I teach students how to learn.

Having taught in both public and private school systems, I have seen first-hand how our students are expected to learn - but they are rarely given the tools or strategies to do so.

Since 2006, I have personally coached thousands of students, one-on-one, on:

standardized tests (SAT/ACT, SSAT, GRE)
application essays
study skills
executive functions
writing and reading instruction

I work with students in grade 6 through graduate school, as well as adults looking to further their work productivity habits.

With a Master's Degree in Special Education, I specialize in the intersection between ADHD and academics. I also work with students with ASD and other learning disabilities. I can work in communion with your child's IEP and can help you to navigate and understand your child's services.

In addition to being a private executive function coach, I'm also a mother of two teens.
